protocol.trained: Logistic readout on train-standardized class mean and squared-activity features. Fixed recurrent weights, input projection, bias and time constants.
protocol.scope: Every retained MaleCNS neuron and source edge participates before explicit candidate pruning. A decision arena visualizes final classifier actions; it is not a physics or whole-fly behavior simulation.
protocol.selection: Checkpoint chosen by validation loss; test evaluated after training. Both architectures shown descriptively.
protocol.normalization: Observed target-row counts normalized to 0.95; GABA negative, other transmitters positive approximation.
protocol.timing: Median of 7 warmed full 6-step decisions, measured on this device; rendering excluded.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired seed bootstrap, exploratory; fresh task seeds generated per experiment. Small samples do not prove general superiority.

environment.source: Measured verification run on the development CPU; not this browser
